description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order under Sec. 85 of Inland Revenue Act, as being the Service's rendered with a Source in Sri Lanka and Pays to a resident Individual being
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of regulations under the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017. The Minister of Finance and Mass Media is exercising powers vested by this Act to prescribe specific regulations regarding services subject to taxation and tax rates for payments to non-residents. This constitutes regulatory/legal matters falling under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes), as it involves statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
